transcript.speaker: p-gwen
transcript.text: Okay, recording's on. Thanks all. Let's go through the open items, shortest first. Talia, anything urgent from your side?

transcript.speaker: p-talia
transcript.text: Not urgent but a few things 😬 two POs still waiting on acknowledgment from the supplier, I chased them yesterday 🙏

transcript.speaker: p-gwen
transcript.text: Which ones? The machined parts or the electronics?

transcript.speaker: p-talia
transcript.text: Electronics mostly. One of them is a long lead connector, I think, don't quote me, Samir knows 🙏

transcript.speaker: p-nora
transcript.text: While Samir pulls up his notes, quick one from manufacturing. The build schedule for the test packs is still the same on my side, so let me know if anything changes.

transcript.speaker: p-kofi
transcript.text: Uh, also the battery enclosure samples came in. They look fine, I think. I haven't measured them yet.

transcript.speaker: p-gwen
transcript.text: Okay. Samir, cells.

transcript.speaker: p-samir
transcript.text: yeah. so cell supplier update, 21700 cells for test packs, the date moved again, now 10/15. they said it was the formation capacity, not a shipping problem

transcript.speaker: p-gwen
transcript.text: That's the second push. Did they give a reason for the second one?

transcript.speaker: p-samir
transcript.text: same reason. i asked if they can split the lot and they said they'll look at it. not sure thats a real answer

transcript.speaker: p-kofi
transcript.text: I think the test lab can live with a split. Probably. Not 100% sure, we'd need a minimum count to run the pack balancing tests, I'd have to check with Dmitri.

transcript.speaker: p-nora
transcript.text: To restate, the question is whether we can start the pack builds with a partial lot. 1. Builds need a full set per pack. 2. We could start with one pack. 3. I'd rather not start a partial set if the rest slips again.

transcript.speaker: p-gwen
transcript.text: Understood. Samir, ask them for a firm date in writing.

transcript.speaker: p-samir
transcript.text: will do, EOW. well, thurs, i'll try

transcript.speaker: p-talia
transcript.text: fyi I got a quote for the heat shrink in, it's a bit higher than last time, still ok 🙏

transcript.speaker: p-gwen
transcript.text: Fine. Don't approve until we see the total.

transcript.speaker: p-kofi
transcript.text: Uh, can I jump in about the aluminum stock? The vendor said lead time is shorter than they told us, I think, maybe a week less.

transcript.speaker: p-gwen
transcript.text: Get it in writing. We've been burned on that before.

transcript.speaker: p-nora
transcript.text: On manufacturing, 1. The fixture plates are cut and need anodize. 2. The anodize shop has a queue. 3. I'd like Talia to confirm the slot.

transcript.speaker: p-talia
transcript.text: confirmed, I'll send the PO today 🙏

transcript.speaker: p-samir
transcript.text: sorry, what was that about the anodize, the audio dropped

transcript.speaker: p-nora
transcript.text: The fixture plates, they need to go to the anodize shop this week.

transcript.speaker: p-gwen
transcript.text: Wait, wait, sorry, my dog. Okay. Kofi, anything on the packaging for the actuator shipments?

transcript.speaker: p-kofi
transcript.text: I think we're fine for now. The foam inserts are on the shelf. Probably enough for the next two.

transcript.speaker: p-gwen
transcript.text: Okay. Let's do a quick pass on open POs, then I'll let you go.

transcript.speaker: p-talia
transcript.text: I'll paste the list into the channel after 😬

transcript.speaker: p-gwen
transcript.text: Anything else? No. Thanks everyone, I'll send out the notes.
